Must have skills : Edge Computing Good to have skills : NAMinimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: As an Edge Computing and Computer Vision Technical Lead, you will design and develop Edge AI and Computer Vision solutions involving cameras, sensors, edge compute platforms and Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) models. You will be expected to contribute hands-on to solution design, development, model deployment and optimization while guiding engineering teams through Proof of Concept (PoC), pilot and production deployments. Roles & Responsibilities: Design and develop end-to-end Edge AI and Computer Vision solutions. Evaluate and integrate edge compute platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, industrial Personal Computers (PCs), Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) and Neural Processing Unit (NPU) based devices. Work with RGB (Red-Green-Blue), thermal/infrared, low-light, stereo, depth and Time-of-Flight (ToF) camera technologies. Integrate cameras, sensors and actuators such as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging), radar, ultrasonic sensors, Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs), relays, motors and Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs). Develop Computer Vision applications for object detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, Optical Character Recognition (OCR), pose estimation and anomaly detection. Work with model architectures such as YOLO, SSD, Faster R-CNN, Mask R-CNN, DETR, U-Net and Vision Transformers (ViTs). Optimize models for edge deployment using quantization, pruning, FP16/INT8 inference and hardware acceleration. Develop video and inference pipelines using OpenCV, GStreamer, NVIDIA TensorRT, NVIDIA DeepStream, Intel OpenVINO and ONNX Runtime. Work with camera interfaces and protocols such as USB, MIPI-CSI (Mobile Industry Processor Interface ?? Camera Serial Interface), GigE Vision, RTSP (Real-Time Streaming Protocol) and ONVIF. Support camera calibration, multi-camera synchronization, image preprocessing and sensor fusion. Develop edge applications using Python, C/C++, Linux and Docker/container technologies. Implement device monitoring, logging, Over-the-Air (OTA) software/model updates and remote troubleshooting capabilities. Support edge-to-cloud integration using MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport), REST APIs and Internet of Things (IoT) platforms. Participate in Proof of Concept, pilot and production deployments at customer locations. Troubleshoot issues across cameras, edge hardware, operating systems, networks, AI models and applications. Guide junior engineers and contribute to technical reviews and solution design discussions. Professional & Technical Skills: Must To Have Skills: Strong hands-on experience in Edge Computing, Computer Vision and Machine Learning. Good understanding of NVIDIA Jetson, industrial edge PCs and AI accelerator-based hardware. Strong knowledge of camera technologies, image/video processing and camera integration. Strong understanding of Computer Vision algorithms and model architectures. Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow and Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX). Strong programming experience in Python and preferably C/C++. Experience optimizing models for latency, Frames Per Second (FPS), memory, power and compute constraints. Experience with Linux, Docker and embedded/edge software environments. Understanding of networking, IoT protocols and edge-to-cloud communication. Experience handling real-world Computer Vision challenges such as low light, glare, occlusion, motion blur, vibration and changing environmental conditions. Understanding of Machine Learning Operations (MLOps), model versioning and deployment lifecycle. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across hardware and software layers. The candidate should have minimum 8 years of overall software engineering experience with significant hands-on experience in Edge Computing and Computer Vision. Candidate should have experience taking at least one Computer Vision solution from Proof of Concept through pilot or production deployment. Experience with distributed deployments involving multiple cameras and edge devices is preferred. Experience in industrial, manufacturing, transportation, automotive, retail, robotics or smart infrastructure domains will be an advantage. This position is based at our Bengaluru office. A 15 years full time education is required. Qualification 15 years full time education 8-13 Yrs Algorithms, Container, Intelligence, Computer vision, Classification, Embedded systems, Graphics, Docker

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary Guidewire is seeking an AI Engineer to join our Professional Services AI Engineering team in Bangalore. You will work as a dedicated AI-side member of a Strike Team, pairing with a Product Engineer to deliver AI productization projects end-to-end. Your primary craft is harness engineering and prompt engineering - building the agent harnesses, tool integrations, prompts, and eval loops that turn an LLM into a production feature. Around that core, you will also handle the supporting AI work: data parsing, embeddings, RAG pipelines, light ML work, and accuracy validation. You will help shape the technical approach alongside our AI Architect and partner with a Senior AI Engineer on the deeper architectural calls, contributing your own ideas and knowing when to bring in specialist support. This role suits someone who has solid AI fundamentals and is excited to go deep on agent and prompt design as their day job. Key Responsibilities Harness Engineering: Build and maintain the LLM harnesses that power each AI feature - agent loops, tool/function calling, context construction, memory, retries, and failure handling. Use frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or LangGraph where they fit; write custom orchestration where they dont. Prompt Engineering: Design, iterate, and version prompts as first-class assets. Run structured prompt experiments, measure deltas with eval datasets, and keep prompt libraries clean and reviewable. RAG Pipelines: Build and operate Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines that extract information from documents and parse it into structured knowledge bases - chunking, indexing, retrieval, reranking, prompt assembly, and response handling - collaborating with the AI Architect to shape and refine the patterns. Embeddings & Vector Indexes: Generate embeddings and manage vector indexes (e.g., OpenSearch, Pinecone, pgvector). Tune indexes for retrieval quality and cost. Data Parsing & Curation: Build extraction and parsing pipelines for documents, structured records, and customer datasets so they are clean, labeled, and ready for downstream AI work. Accuracy Validation: Write and operate accuracy validation scripts. Maintain evaluation datasets and report quality metrics to the Strike Team and the AI Architect. Light ML Work: Apply traditional ML where appropriate - classification, clustering, lightweight fine-tuning - to complement LLM-based components. Analysis: Do the data analysis that informs AI design decisions - sample inspection, error analysis, prompt iteration. Key Metrics (KPIs) & Success Metrics AI feature accuracy and quality against eval datasets meets the project bar. Prompt iteration velocity with measurable eval deltas on owned features. RAG and retrieval quality (relevance, groundedness) for owned pipelines. On-time delivery of AI-side Strike Team commitments. Eval coverage: golden and regression sets maintained for owned features. Key Skills & Experience Education: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related technical field. Experience: 3+ years of AI or data science experience, with hands-on time in LLM-based application development. Technical Proficiency: Strong Python skills, including the standard data science stack (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn). Hands-on experience building LLM harnesses - agent loops, tool/function calling, structured outputs - against APIs like Anthropic, OpenAI, or Bedrock. Strong prompt engineering practice: structured iteration, prompt versioning, and prompt evaluation against datasets. Working experience with at least one orchestration framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph) and at least one vector database. Comfortable with embeddings, similarity search, and basic retrieval evaluation. Working knowledge of classical ML for analysis and lightweight modeling tasks. Comfort using AI coding assistants (Claude Code) for daily work. Engineering Excellence: Able to write clean, tested code that ships to production - not just notebooks. Familiar with Git, code review, and basic CI/CD. Analytical Mindset: Strong instinct for data analysis, error inspection, and iterative experimentation. Preferred Skills & Experience Agent Frameworks: Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents) or custom agent harnesses in production. Evals: Experience building structured eval harnesses (golden sets, regression suites, LLM-as-judge patterns). Cloud: Hands-on AWS experience (Bedrock, SageMaker, OpenSearch). Fine-Tuning: Any experience with model fine-tuning or distillation. Guidewire Knowledge: Familiarity with Guidewire products or the insurance domain is a plus. Take ownership of the main demo template, ensuring its stability and beginning the process of refreshing demo data and documentation. Contribute your first prospect-specific agent builds to active sales opportunities, gaining hands-on experience in high-stakes scenarios. Within 180 Days, You'll Significantly expand the standard demo agent library, incorporating new use cases and refining existing agents based on SE feedback and market needs. Demonstrate clear contributions to closed deals through your custom Scout builds, directly impacting sales wins and validating your approach. Successfully diagnose and tune struggling POC instances, applying your analytical skills to improve prospect engagement and conversion rates. Within 365 Days, You'll Own a comprehensive, high-performing library of Scout demo agents that are consistently leveraged by the Sales Engineering team, becoming an indispensable asset for sales cycles. Regularly contribute to the closure of significant deals through your expert prospect-specific agent builds and POC tuning, directly influencing revenue growth. We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Power BI, MS SQL Server, React.js, Python, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and data analytics. The ideal candidate will possess strong software engineering fundamentals, programming expertise, analytical problem-solving capabilities, and practical experience designing and developing AI-enabled enterprise applications. The role requires the ability to integrate structured and unstructured enterprise data with modern AI technologies while ensuring application scalability, security, reliability, and performance. Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, semantic modeling, dashboard development, and Power BI Service. Extensive experience with MS SQL Server and T-SQL, including complex queries, stored procedures, views, database design, and performance optimization. Strong hands-on expertise in React.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. Strong programming experience in Python, including API development, automation, data processing, and integration. Solid understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and design patterns. Hands-on experience developing Generative AI and LLM-powered applications. Practical knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture, implementation, and optimization. Experience working with vector databases such as Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS, or pgvector. Understanding of embeddings, semantic search, vector similarity, document chunking, retrieval strategies, and context augmentation. Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent LLM application frameworks. Experience integrating LLM APIs, REST services, enterprise databases, and frontend applications. Strong understanding of data analytics, data modeling, data transformation, and reporting solutions. Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Agile software development practices. Knowledge of secure application development, data privacy, authentication, authorization, and enterprise AI governance. Strong analytical thinking, debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to independently design, develop, deploy, and support enterprise-grade software and AI-enabled solutions. Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, and enterprise data governance. Experience building AI-powered dashboards, conversational analytics, or natural-language interfaces for enterprise data. Experience developing applications in large-scale, highly regulated environments. Software Engineering & Application Development Design, develop, enhance, and maintain scalable enterprise applications, analytical platforms, and AI-enabled solutions. Develop modern, responsive, and interactive web applications using React.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. Build reusable frontend components, dashboards, and application interfaces. Develop and integrate RESTful APIs, backend services, and enterprise data integrations. Implement application functionality using Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, or equivalent programming languages. Apply software engineering best practices, including modular architecture, clean coding, unit testing, code reviews, and performance optimization. Troubleshoot complex application, integration, performance, and production issues. Collaborate with product owners, data engineers, AI engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable technical solutions. Power BI & Data Analytics Design, develop, deploy, and maintain enterprise Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions. Translate complex business requirements into interactive dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, and actionable insights. Develop Power BI semantic models, advanced DAX measures, calculated columns, and Power Query transformations. Integrate Power BI with MS SQL Server, APIs, enterprise applications, and other structured data sources. Optimize dashboard performance, data refresh processes, query execution, and reporting efficiency. Implement row-level security, workspace access controls, and data governance best practices. Analyze large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, operational risks, and opportunities for improvement. Develop automated reporting and analytical solutions to improve business decision-making. Explore AI-assisted analytics, natural-language querying, and intelligent insights across enterprise data. MS SQL Server & Database Engineering Design, develop, maintain, and optimize SQL Server databases and enterprise data solutions. Develop complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, views, and database scripts. Perform query optimization, indexing, execution plan analysis, and database performance tuning. Develop data extraction, transformation, and integration workflows to support applications, analytics, and AI use cases. Implement relational data models and ensure data quality, consistency, integrity, and security. Integrate SQL Server data with Power BI, React applications, Python services, and AI-powered applications. Support structured data retrieval and integration with Generative AI and RAG solutions. Troubleshoot database performance, connectivity, and data processing issues. Generative AI & LLM Application Development Design, develop, and integrate Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities into enterprise applications. Build AI-powered applications using Python and frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration frameworks. Integrate LLM APIs and enterprise AI platforms, including Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Google Vertex AI, or equivalent services. Develop intelligent applications supporting natural-language search, document summarization, knowledge retrieval, conversational interfaces, and analytical insights. Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool/function calling, and context management techniques. Develop reusable AI services and REST APIs for integration with React-based applications and enterprise platforms. Evaluate LLM responses for accuracy, relevance, latency, cost, and reliability. Implement guardrails, secure prompt handling, sensitive-data protection, and responsible AI practices. Troubleshoot AI application issues involving model responses, context limitations, integration failures, and performance. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Vector Databases Design, develop, implement, and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using enterprise structured and unstructured data. Build document ingestion, preprocessing, chunking, embedding generation, indexing, retrieval, and response generation pipelines. Work with vector databases such as Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS, or PostgreSQL with pgvector. Implement semantic search, similarity search, metadata filtering, and hybrid retrieval techniques. Integrate vector databases with LLMs, Python services, and enterprise knowledge repositories. Develop enterprise knowledge assistants, document search applications, and AI-powered question-answering solutions. Implement embedding models, vector indexing strategies, retrieval optimization, and reranking techniques. Improve RAG response quality through retrieval evaluation, grounding, citation generation, and hallucination reduction. Integrate SQL Server and other enterprise data sources with RAG workflows where appropriate. Implement document-level access controls, data isolation, secure retrieval, and appropriate handling of confidential enterprise information. Monitor and optimize retrieval accuracy, response latency, token usage, and overall AI application performance. Programming, Automation & API Integration Develop automation solutions using Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, PowerShell, and SQL. Build backend services and APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Node.js, or equivalent technologies. Automate data ingestion, validation, transformation, reporting, and operational workflows. Develop reusable scripts and components for AI applications, analytics platforms, and enterprise integrations. Integrate REST APIs, LLM APIs, vector databases, SQL Server, and frontend applications. Implement error handling, logging, exception management, and automated testing. Support CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools. Apply version control, secure coding standards, and automated deployment practices. Analytical Problem Solving & Intelligent Solutions Analyze complex business and technical problems and translate requirements into scalable software and analytical solutions. Develop data-driven insights using SQL, Power BI, Python, and AI-assisted analytical techniques. Identify opportunities to apply Generative AI, semantic search, RAG, and intelligent automation to enterprise workflows. Perform data profiling, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and root cause analysis. Evaluate AI use cases based on feasibility, business value, security, accuracy, and operational impact. Collaborate with stakeholders to define KPIs, reporting requirements, and intelligent application capabilities. Communicate technical findings and analytical insights effectively to technical and non-technical audiences. Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Full medical cover for you from your first day, no waiting period. Generous work-from-home policy. We trust engineers to work from where they do their best thinking.
